title: Mechvibes soundpack config.json (V2)
description: Describes what src/utils/soundpack_validator.rs accepts as a valid V2 pack, no more. Key names, audio files and playback fields are not validated by the app at this stage, so they are not constrained here either. See docs/soundpack-config-v2.md.

allOf.description: `author` is required. The legacy `m_author` spelling only counts when config_version is declared as 2 (validator: with no version, the pack is only recognised as V2 when `author` is present).
`defs` is only read when `definitions` is absent, so it is only checked in that case.

name.description: Display name. The validator only checks that the field exists; the app reads it as a string.

author.description: Pack creator. Library packs: written by the server on publish.

author_url.description: Optional link to the author's profile. Written by the library server; the app ignores it.

id.description: Becomes the install folder name, so it must be a single path component (soundpack_installer.rs validate_soundpack_id). `mv-<32 hex>` is reserved for library-issued packs and `default-` for the bundled packs published to the library; the validator does not enforce either.

config_version.description: The V2 declaration, as the number 2 or the string "2" (surrounding whitespace and leading zeros are tolerated by the validator).

version.description: Pack version. The app reads it only when it is a string and ignores any other type. Library packs: an integer string equal to the server revision, for example "3".

timingPair.description: [start, end]. The validator checks the length only.

keyDefinitions.description: Key name to timing. Each value is either `{ "timing": [[start, end], ...] }` or the timing array itself.
